summary: Master pension fund performance measurement, fair presentation, and attribution modeling. Optimize your fund's investment strategy and reporting. Enroll today.
lede: Pension fund benchmarking and performance measurement help investment professionals assess portfolio results against suitable benchmarks, risk and liabilities. For analysts, trustees, investment leaders and portfolio managers, the course develops skills in constructing benchmarks, comparing risk-adjusted returns and using attribution to identify performance drivers. It also covers connecting investment results to liabilities and presenting findings to investment committees.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for the financial integrity and strategic direction of retirement schemes and institutional portfolios.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of investment concepts and basic financial mathematics. Experience working within a pension fund, asset management firm, or investment consultancy is highly recommended. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis is required as the course involves practical calculation exercises.
